mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We have overcast skies at Badger Prairie County Park with a temperature of 69 degrees, though it feels a bit warmer at 71. We are currently under a waning crescent moon.

The city has announced ongoing engineering updates managed by AECOM, and the Senior Center is currently looking for volunteers to help with their tri-shaw bike program that offers free rides along the Military Ridge State Trail.

We have a busy couple of days ahead! Today, catch live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard and the Wisconsin Brewing Company, or check out the girls hockey event at the Verona Ice Arena. Tomorrow, you can join a yoga session at Insight Wellness.
To keep you informed on local safety, on July 31, an officer conducted a traffic stop that resulted in a driver being arrested for O W I and cited for suspended vehicle registration.
Today's flavor of the day is Snickers Swirl. The store is currently closed but will be ready to serve you starting at 10 AM. Tomorrow's flavor will be Georgia Peach.
